sources.title: What a sea mine explosion looks like
sources.author: U.S. Navy
sources.processing: HP 30 Hz; onset trimmed; boom + geyser whoosh + splash-down layers; cosine fade-out; look-ahead peak limiter (2 ms, 80 ms release, up to 1.5 dB GR); layer: real underwater mine detonation, water column
sources.provenance_note: Official U.S. military channel upload; U.S. federal government work (17 U.S.C. 105, public domain); YouTube license field: Creative Commons Attribution license (reuse allowed); uploaded 20130510. This underwater detonation by U.S. Navy Explosive Ordnance Disposal illustrates the destructive potential of a sea mine. Find out what Navy is doing to keep the sea safe from mines - http://ow.ly/l3uSR.
